# Unsubscribe from Tidy Tuesday {#status-title .unnumbered .unlisted}

[Click below and you won't receive any more Tidy Tuesday emails. You can always subscribe again later.]{#status-text .lede}

```{=html}
<p><button id="unsub-button" class="btn-ak" type="button">Unsubscribe me</button></p>
<script>
(function () {
  var token = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("token"),
      endpoint = document.body.dataset.subscribeEndpoint,
      btn = document.getElementById("unsub-button"),
      title = document.getElementById("status-title"), text = document.getElementById("status-text");
  if (!token || !endpoint) { btn.hidden = true; text.textContent = "This link is missing its code. Please use the unsubscribe link in one of my emails."; return; }
  btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
    btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Unsubscribing…";
    fetch(endpoint + "/unsubscribe?token=" + encodeURIComponent(token), { method: "POST" })
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) {
        btn.hidden = true;
        title.textContent = d.ok ? "You've been unsubscribed" : "That link didn't work";
        text.textContent = d.ok ? "You won't receive any more Tidy Tuesday emails. Thank you for following along, and you're always welcome back." : d.message;
      })
      .catch(function () { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = "Unsubscribe me"; text.textContent = "Couldn't reach the server. Please try again."; });
  });
})();
</script>
```
:::
